summary: Kimi Antonelli arrives at Austin with pole position and a golden opportunity to clinch his maiden world title this weekend, ending Mercedes' championship drought. Charles Leclerc's Ferrari threatens to disrupt Antonelli's coronation after leading Friday practice, setting up a fierce battle for victory on a track marred by dangerous bumps that have drawn complaints from Max Verstappen. A win for Antonelli would secure the championship and establish Mercedes as title contenders once again, while a Leclerc victory would keep the fight alive heading into the final races.
